title: Around the Fallen Tree
story: The walking club meant to meet their minibus at the valley car park at four. A fallen tree blocked the direct lane, and the sky was dim. Their guide, Nia, chose a farm track above the blockage. It was longer, but the ground was firm. Two members wanted to climb the tree, because the car park looked close. Nia pointed at the wet branches and the slope beyond them. A slip would leave someone below the lane with no easy way back. The group took the farm track in single file. They arrived muddy and twenty minutes late. The driver had waited, and nobody had to be rescued.

vocabulary.definition: A small bus used to carry a group.
Something that stops people getting through.
Ground that rises or falls at an angle.

quiz.question: Where had the club agreed to meet the minibus?
options: At the valley car park at four
On the farm track above the tree
Below the lane, beside the slope
At the start of the walk at noon
quiz.correctAnswer: At the valley car park at four
quiz.explanation: The walking club meant to meet their minibus at the valley car park at four.
quiz.supportingSentence: The walking club meant to meet their minibus at the valley car park at four.

quiz.question: What does the warning about a slip suggest was most important to Nia?
options: Arriving earlier than the minibus
Keeping people from a fall, ahead of saving time
Proving that the farm track was blocked too
Getting someone rescued from under the tree
quiz.correctAnswer: Keeping people from a fall, ahead of saving time
quiz.explanation: She points out that a slip would leave someone below the lane, so safety outweighs the shorter climb.
quiz.supportingSentence: A slip would leave someone below the lane with no easy way back.

quiz.question: Why did two members want to climb the tree?
options: The driver had told them to
The farm track was under water
The car park looked close
Nia had lost the map
quiz.explanation: Two members wanted to climb the tree because the car park looked close.
quiz.supportingSentence: Two members wanted to climb the tree, because the car park looked close.

quiz.question: What does the ending suggest about the longer route?
options: The driver left before the group arrived
A walker had to be rescued from the tree
The farm track was shorter than the blocked lane
The extra time was worth it because nobody needed rescuing
quiz.correctAnswer: The extra time was worth it because nobody needed rescuing
quiz.explanation: They arrive late, the driver has waited, and nobody has to be rescued, so the safer route did its job.
quiz.supportingSentence: The driver had waited, and nobody had to be rescued.

quiz.question: What is the blockage in this story?
options: The fallen tree that shut the direct lane
The minibus that arrived too early
A river across the farm track
Fog that hid the valley car park
quiz.correctAnswer: The fallen tree that shut the direct lane
quiz.explanation: A fallen tree blocks the direct lane, and Nia chooses a track above that blockage.
quiz.supportingSentence: Their guide, Nia, chose a farm track above the blockage.
